data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avrom total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_hebrew.name: Avrom
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Father of a multitude
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Avrom הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Hebrew, Avram means 'father of a multitude'. In the Bible, this name is given to Abraham, the patriarch of the Jewish people. God promised Abraham that he would be the father of many nations.

in_latin.name: Avrom
in_latin.long_meaning: Nominum significatio est derivatio ex linguarum semitis. Nominum Avrom derivatio est a linguarum semitis Hebraicus et Graecus. Nominum significatio est 'paternitas' et 'stabilitas'.
